::: {}
Qploidy2 is designed for large-scale copy-number variation, ploidy, and aneuploidy estimation using genotyping-platform data. Its workflow includes methods based on allele-ratio information and Hidden Markov Models.

{{< tool-tags >}}
:::
<img class="software-logo" src="../assets/software-qploidy2.png" alt="Qploidy2 logo">
:::

```r
# Development version

```

- Aneuploidy detection
